preflight_query:
select jsonb_build_object(
'server_version',current_setting('server_version'),
'private_schema',to_regnamespace('private') is not null,
'engine_check',(select pg_get_constraintdef(oid) from pg_constraint where conrelid='public.estimate_versions'::regclass and conname='estimate_versions_calc_engine_version_check'),
'unsupported_engines',(select count(*) from public.estimate_versions where calc_engine_version not in (1,2)),
'negative_supplier_prices',(select count(*) from public.supplier_pricebook where unit_price_cents < 0),
'zero_price_kind_exists',exists(select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='supplier_pricebook' and column_name='zero_price_kind'),
'catalogue_page_exists',to_regprocedure('public.catalogue_products_page(text,text[],text[],text[],text[],text[],text,text,integer,integer)') is not null,
'catalogue_summary_exists',to_regprocedure('public.catalogue_products_summary()') is not null,
'purchase_order_drafts_exists',to_regprocedure('public.create_estimate_purchase_order_drafts(uuid,uuid,jsonb,jsonb)') is not null,
'update_supplier_offer_exists',to_regprocedure('public.update_supplier_offer(uuid,jsonb)') is not null,
'measurement_units_exists',to_regclass('public.measurement_units') is not null,
'measurement_aliases_exists',to_regclass('public.measurement_unit_aliases') is not null,
'pricing_status_exists',to_regtype('public.estimate_line_pricing_status') is not null,
'encoding',getdatabaseencoding()
) as preflight;
